inspection.officer_note: Plot largely neglected; shed roof unsafe.

deciding.cultivation_breach: Growing season: 6 of 25 m2 cultivated (covered bed counts as uncultivated), so a shortfall exists. Start_date 2023-12-24 is about 179 days before the visit, just inside the 180-day grace with exemption null. Grace leans false, but it is borderline.
deciding.notice_ladder_met: The warning has served_on null, so service is unrecorded, although the deadline has passed and reinspection followed. Leaning false with some doubt that it was actually served.
deciding.next_action: Deadline passed and reinspected, which would support final_notice, but served_on is null and grace is borderline, so warning_notice stays plausible. The unmitigated unsafe shed is a further reason to act.
deciding.recurrence_count: Previous visit showed 0 of 3 beds cultivated, and the one warning issued in April may count as one prior logging. First occurrence versus once before is balanced.
deciding.uncultivated_extent: Uncultivated is 19 of 25 m2, about 76%, right at the 75% boundary between levels 2 and 3. Level 3 edges ahead only because the covered bed counts as uncultivated in the growing season.
